hints.title: Treat Graph as Undirected Tree
hints.text: Build an adjacency list treating all edges as bidirectional, tagging which direction is the original road.

hints.title: Traverse Outwards from City 0
hints.text: Start a tree traversal at city 0. For each neighbor v, if the original edge directed from current city to v, that road must be reversed.

hints.title: Count Edge Reversals
hints.text: Accumulate the count of reversed edges when traversing outwards from 0 to all other nodes.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rechecking all paths from every node to 0 takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since the road network is a tree, a single search outwards from 0 visits every edge once.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate inverts the direction thinking: traverse outward from 0 and count outgoing edges.
complexity.notes: n - 1 roads connecting n cities with no cycles.

solutions.approach: undirected tree traversal outward from 0 with original edge direction penalty
